items.title: Alphonse Picou Interview, 1958-04-04
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Morton was Jelly Roll Morton. Oh, of course. You're fine with me. Do you ever remember Jelly Roll Morton playing in the district? ... [INTERVIEWEE] Oh. No.

ctx.x: You know more than me? Yeah. Do you ever remember Wine Boy at the time? Yeah.

Morton was Jelly Roll Morton. Oh, of course. You're fine with me. Do you ever remember Jelly Roll Morton playing in the district? Who? Jelly Roll Morton in the district? Oh, sure. Did he play in the district that you remember? Oh. No.

Well, when you played at Lula White's, how many did they have in the band? Did they have... All in two. Just two? Clarinet and piano? That's all. Mm-hmm. Clarinet and piano. Anybody sing? Yeah. Come and sing a song. We have to play. That would be just in the front parlor then. Okay. If you just play in the front parlor, is that like with Tony Jackson? Yeah. Tony Jackson. What hours would you work at Lula's? How late?
